thread:
rachel: hi all ":wave:" quick onboarding Qs — i bought a laptop yesterday (receipt attached) because my home setup needed it before my start. is there a pre-start hardware reimbursement flow? also my benefits page shows "pending effective date: 04/01/2026" but my offer said coverage starts on my first day (03/29). will I be covered for the 03/31 holiday? my direct deposit says pending verification (bank last4 4321). who should I message so none of this blocks first paycheck or holiday pay?

emily (people-ops): welcome rachel! :tada: short answers: yes on reimbursement (with approvals), benefits effective date depends on plan rules, and direct deposit needs payroll to verify. can you do 2 quick things: 1) upload your laptop receipt to https://expenses.redwood.com/upload with filename rachel_laptop_receipt.pdf and tag your manager; 2) share the benefits confirmation email if you have it. i'll loop payroll/benefits here.

people-ops-bot: payroll-run:2026-03-28 17:00 UTC — payroll export complete. Cutoff for changes to that cycle was 2026-03-28 14:00 UTC. Submissions after cutoff apply to next run.

luisa (payroll): hi rachel  hi emily  thanks for tagging. on direct deposit: if verification is "pending" we usually do micro-deposits within 24-48 hrs once account is added. if those don't complete before cutoff, payroll will default pay to the paperless PayCard for the first cycle. to avoid that, upload a voided check or a bank screenshot with routing/account and filename rachel_direct_deposit.png. also, for holiday pay: payroll follows the holiday eligibility rule — employees active on the holiday date are eligible. since 03/31 is after your start 03/29, you should be eligible so long as your employment record is active in the HR system on 03/31. i'll verify the employment record once benefits confirms.

tom (benefits): hi rachel  coverage effective dates vary by carrier. some carriers set effective date to the first of the month after enrollment (which explains 04/01), others use date of hire. please forward your enrollment confirmation (or screenshot) to benefits@redwood.com. if your carrier's effective date is 04/01 but you were expecting 03/29, we can request an exception with the broker for first-pay protection; that request takes 48-72 hrs to process. also, HSA/FSA elections have separate cutoffs — if you want HSA contributions to start immediately we need your election in the benefits portal before the payroll feed cutoff.

rachel: uploaded rachel_laptop_receipt.pdf and rachel_direct_deposit.png to the links above. forwarded enrollment confirmation to benefits@redwood.com. manager approved the laptop purchase in Slack DM.

emily (people-ops): thanks! tom  can you confirm whether the broker will backdate coverage or at least protect holiday pay? luisa  can payroll double-check employment active flag for 03/31 so holiday is paid and deposits go to bank acct not paycard?

luisa (payroll): will check employment flag now. if benefits confirms 04/01 as carrier effective date we can still mark the record "active" for payroll eligibility on 03/31 to honor the holiday, but note that medical deductions won't start until carrier effective date unless broker backdates. if deductions need retro-adjustment we can process a retro contribution change.

tom (benefits): broker ACKed and requesting re-eval. ticket #BEN-4472 opened. ETA 2026-03-30 11:00 UTC. I'll escalate for holiday-pay protection. note: for the laptop reimbursement, benefits/people-ops don't process that — it's an expense policy item. expensing steps are in the handbook: get manager approval (done), submit receipt in Expensify, select pre-start hardware category, and tag "onboarding-approval". finance will route payment and it usually lands within 1 payroll cycle. if you need faster, submit a direct reimbursement request to finance@redwood.com and cc emily.

rachel: got it. one more small thing  do i have to opt into 401k before my first paycheck to get matching? i'm still seeing "pending" in the 401k portal.

luisa (payroll): 401k elections must be captured before the payroll cutoff to apply that cycle. if it's pending and misses the cutoff, we can request a retro match once enrollment processes but it needs HR signoff. if you want me to bundle the laptop reimbursement and any retro match requests, i can do that once the expense posts and your enrollment finalizes.

people-ops-bot: ticket BEN-4472 updated: broker responded "investigating carrier rules". ETA unchanged.

emily (people-ops): rachel  thanks for being on top of this. next steps for you: 1) confirm manager approval in Expensify after you submit receipt, 2) if you care about immediate bank deposit, reply here once micro-deposits show, 3) if holiday pay doesn't show on paystub, ping payroll and we'll request off-cycle holiday pay. welcome again! :sparkles:

rachel: thank you all so much  uploading final bits now. appreciate the quick help :pray:
